history: v1: 24 cases, 21/24 on the Phase 0 corpus (misses: plan-pace, plan-productize, move-repo).

v2: the corpus grew (all departments). Dedup to one passage per section fixed plan-pace. Adjudicated as correct sources that were previously unaccepted, after reading their text: Directive 105 for plan-money ('the OS never moves money'), Directive 110 for plan-productize ('only after departments 1-6 have run your own company for 60+ days'), and the plan's top section for move-repo (it contains the git subtree split instructions, so v1 mis-scored it). 12 department questions added before measuring; 11 hit.
Remaining misses are paraphrase or keyword dilution (ADR 0003). They are recorded, not tuned away.
note: Deterministic, so the floor equals the measured score (rounded down). Raise it when retrieval improves; lower it only with a written reason in the same commit.
